summary: V5 features tested end-to-end. Backend: added /app/backend/tests/test_v5_match_snooze.py (4 tests) covering POST /api/stories/match and POST /api/reminders/snooze; all 4 pass. Full regression across all backend tests: 41/41 pass in ~33s. Frontend: /stories matcher-input + matcher-submit render matcher-results with match-{id} buttons; ISB Marketing Club returned as top result for the leadership/authority query with italic reason + capitalized fit label; clicking result opens story-modal. Home /: reminders show hover-revealed reminder-snooze-{id} (clock) and reminder-dismiss-{id} (X); snooze click removes the row and hits /api/reminders/snooze successfully. Home greeting/brief/reminders all load. No issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: reminders.py /snooze uses same ReminderDismissIn model — fine, but consider a distinct schema name for clarity.
stories.py /match trusts LLM ranking output; catalog snippet trimmed to 240 chars which is fine.
Snooze/dismiss state persists in singleton settings doc across test runs — tests correctly use throwaway persons to avoid polluting seeded ids.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed people for birthday reminders and clean them up after each test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: V5 (Story Matcher + Snooze) passes cleanly. Use throwaway people for reminder snooze/dismiss tests since state persists in singleton settings doc; snoozed_reminders keys only expire the next calendar day. Matcher takes ~3-5s (Claude Sonnet 4.6).
